pages.text: Wheat sacks stood in rows outside the mill. Today was wheat-grinding day.
"I'll carry them inside!" Mumu rolled up both wings. Dad grinned.
Dodo jumped in. "You lift a sack high and run. I know! Watch!"
Dodo lifted a sack into her arms. Her legs trembled.
Thump! Dodo sank down with the whole sack.
"This sack... just got heavier!" She tapped it.
Mumu brought a handcart from the storehouse. Its wheels rattled.
Together, they heaved the sack onto the cart.
Mumu pushed it into the mill. Rattle, rattle. The sacks stacked up neatly.
"All carried!" Then Dad lifted Dodo like a sack and put her on his shoulder. "This sack is the heaviest!" On Dad's shoulder, Dodo flapped her feet.
